beats.text: Are you middle class? Here's where the line is.
Researchers call it middle income if a household earns two thirds to double the typical income.
Each dot is one in a hundred American adults, lined up by household income.
For a family of three, that's about fifty-seven to one hundred seventy thousand dollars a year.
Half of all adults are inside. Twenty-eight percent below, nineteen above.
So the middle isn't one number. It's a wide band, and most people are in it.

sources: Pew Research Center (Sept 2024), Are you in the American middle class? Find out with our income calculator – middle income = size-adjusted household income two-thirds to double the national median; three-person household 2022: about $56,600 to $169,800 (2022 dollars); 2022: lower 28 %, middle 52 %, upper 19 % of US adults (State of the American Middle Class, May 2024).
